mapper.update: CREATE TABLE bike_dispatch_notification ( id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT 'ORDER 或 PI', source_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '首条订单出库流水 ID 或 PI 出库批次 ID', customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL, document_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '销售订单 ID 或执行时 PI ID', document_no VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, batch_no VARCHAR(64) NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL, dispatched_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_dispatch_notice_source (kind, source_id), KEY idx_dispatch_notice_customer (customer_id, id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='实际出库通知'

CREATE TABLE bike_dispatch_notification_read ( notification_id BIGINT NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, read_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), PRIMARY KEY (notification_id, user_id), KEY idx_dispatch_notice_read_user (user_id, notification_id), CONSTRAINT fk_dispatch_notice_read_notice FOREIGN KEY (notification_id) REFERENCES bike_dispatch_notification(id), CONSTRAINT fk_dispatch_notice_read_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES bike_sys_user(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='出库通知按账号保存的已读记录'
